text:
Alex Chen: quick q — can we give the contractor read access to prod logs in Console? need them to triage a SLO alert but we can't expose billing/compute details.
Maria Gomez: i'd avoid org-level Viewer. instead do project-scoped logging role + custom role if they need a couple extra perms. roles/logging.viewer is usually enough.
Alex Chen: ok, so project-level binding to roles/logging.viewer for my-prod-project? any risks re: redaction? logs contain emails/IDs.
Lina R.: redact at ingest if possible, but for now use Logs Viewer + log exclusion/router to drop sensitive payloads. also set access window via time-limited grant and monitor with audit logs.
Jamal Patel: for contractors we prefer JIT or short-lived creds. can use temporary service account impersonation and grant iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the SA, not long-lived user bindings.
sre-bot: reminder: open an access request ticket with justification + expiry, attach least-priv scope. link: https://redwood.atlassian.org/acl-requests
Maria Gomez: example command to add project binding:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-prod-project \
  --member='user:contractor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer'
```
Maria Gomez: example pattern for SA impersonation (preferred):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding sa-logs@my-prod-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member='user:contractor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser'
```
Alex Chen: thanks, i'll open the ACL ticket and request 48h access, include log redaction plan. @Maria @Lina can you review the ACL note when i post?
Maria Gomez: sure, will check :thumbsup:
Lina R.: same — please include which log paths need redaction and the exclusion rule id.
Alex Chen: will do. filing now — thanks everyone.
